summary: Directed to implement Phase 7 ('Export augmented-frame positive persistence') in full, one phase this dispatch, per the Phase 6 handoff's coordination note that it is a fresh substantial phase needing its own dispatch. Closed it completely in a single green checkpoint. Core design: augmented-frame reachability (isAccessible augH x y) is decomposed via two new generic, Atom-independent lemmas (isAccessible_go_decompose/isAccessible_decompose) into a Relation.ReflTransGen chain of single-edge hops, by structural induction on isAccessible.go's own fuel-bounded recursion -- deliberately NOT re-proving isAccessible transitive (the thing Scheme.lean's existing docstring at :250-257 explains the codebase avoids), since go's recursion already IS a single-edge chain. A new provenance invariant (IAugMembers augH edgesH lbH := every augH edge is either a raw edge, already in edgesH, or a loop-back edge, already in lbH, since augH only ever grows by exactly one of those two append operations in lockstep) was threaded through all ten intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat key-induction cases (mirroring exactly how Phase 6 threaded IAllReuseFrozenOrigin), with the two real 'step' proofs at the edge-growing sites (case6 reuse: IAugMembers_lb_snoc; case7 mint: IAugMembers_edges_snoc) and trivial carry-through everywhere else. The payoff lemma IAugMembers_persist combines IAugMembers/IPosPersistRaw/IReuseContain/IWorldsPlanted to derive exactly truthLemma's hpers shape by tail-peeling the decomposed chain (mirroring openBranch_rawEdges_upward_closed's existing tail-peeling proof). intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat's conclusion was extended with this as a 7th conjunct (a deliberate deviation from the plan's 'prefer a corollary' guidance -- the IAugMembers invariant needed threading regardless, so once that existed the derived fact was a one-line corollary at the sole .openBranch leaf, and exposing it as a conjunct keeps a future openBranch_countermodel call a single destructuring). A type-checking example right after the lemma feeds the new conjunct directly into truthLemma's hpers parameter via exact, no coercion, mechanically confirming the shape match. Full CI pipeline green (lake build 3325 jobs, checkInitImports, lake lint zero Scheme.lean findings, lint-style, shake, mk_all, lake test 9397 jobs exit 0). Sorry 196->196, axiom 26->26, vacuous 1->1, all unchanged. Both intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat and openBranch_rawEdges_upward_closed re-verified via lean_verify: standard three axioms, no sorryAx.

decisions_made: Followed the plan's decompose-and-chain design exactly (raw-edge persistence via IPosPersistRaw plus loop-back containment via IReuseContain, chained along ReflTransGen exactly as openBranch_rawEdges_upward_closed does), rather than inventing an alternative augmented-frame persistence proof strategy.

Decomposed isAccessible edges w w' = true into a single-edge ReflTransGen chain via a NEW generic lemma (isAccessible_go_decompose) rather than trying to avoid this by choosing a different exported edges witness (e.g. edgesH ++ lbEdges by construction) -- the augmented augH accumulator is already established, sorry-free, and threaded through five prior phases; redefining it would have been a much larger, riskier refactor touching every existing call site.

Extended intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat's conclusion directly with a 7th conjunct instead of a separate corollary lemma, since the plan's stated precondition for preferring a corollary ('if the induction does not need the new fact threaded through it') did not hold -- IAugMembers itself is unavoidably an induction-level invariant (edge-list provenance cannot be derived post-hoc from the final edges lists alone), so the marginal cost of also exposing the derived fact as a conjunct (versus a wrapper lemma) was one line at the sole leaf case. Recorded as a plan deviation with rationale.

Added a type-checking `example` demonstrating the new conjunct unifies with truthLemma's hpers parameter via a bare `exact`, satisfying the plan's own verification bullet ('demonstrate with a type-checking example or by direct use in Phase 8') without waiting for Phase 8.
dead_ends: Did not attempt to prove isAccessible itself transitive (composing two separate isAccessible facts) -- the codebase's existing docstring at Scheme.lean:250-257 explains this was deliberately avoided as a harder graph-reachability fact; decomposing a SINGLE isAccessible call into single-edge hops (what was actually needed) is a different, much easier direction and does not require it.

Did not attempt to reuse IPosPersistRaw's own proof machinery (applyPersistenceFixpoint_copy_complete) directly for the augmented frame -- that machinery is intrinsically tied to edgesH being the literal edges argument the persistence-copy computation was run with; augH is a separate bookkeeping accumulator the algorithm never threads into applyAllTImpRules, so bPers is not a fixpoint with respect to augH's (larger) accessibility relation and that route does not generalize.
